original: בְּ/רֵאשִׁ֖ית בָּרָ֣א אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֵ֥ת הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם וְ/אֵ֥ת הָ/אָֽרֶץ׃
translation: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
uncertainties: Verse can be read 'When God began to create...' (construct בראשית)
_web_text: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.

original: יְֽהוָ֗ה קָ֭נָ/נִי רֵאשִׁ֣ית דַּרְכּ֑/וֹ קֶ֖דֶם מִפְעָלָ֣י/ו מֵ/אָֽז׃
translation: The LORD acquired me as the beginning of his way, the first of his works of old.
uncertainties: קנה may mean 'acquired', 'possessed' or 'created'; Wisdom speaks
differences_from_web: WEB 'possessed me in the beginning of his work' differs: I take ראשית as 'beginning' in apposition to me, and render קנני 'acquired'
_web_text: “The LORD possessed me in the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old.

original: וְ/נִגְלָ֖ה כְּב֣וֹד יְהוָ֑ה וְ/רָא֤וּ כָל־בָּשָׂר֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו כִּ֛י פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר׃ ס
translation: And the glory of the LORD will be revealed, and all flesh will see it together, for the mouth of the LORD has spoken.
differences_from_web: WEB adds 'it' after 'see' (the Hebrew has an object suffix-less 'see together'); sense is the same
_web_text: The LORD’s glory shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together; for the mouth of the LORD has spoken it.”
